reviewed.by: PENDING — ports the every-code-we-have-traced reel (round 2), which is itself mid-gate. STANDING CONSTRAINTS: (1) 'TRACED TO ITS SOURCE' — never bare 'traced'. The restrictor limits the class to cases where we know the ORIGIN; without it the claim readmits the fatal counterexample, since we know the causal history of billions of information-rich things (every genome ever replicated) and the proximate cause of none of them is a mind. (2) 'ARTIFACT', never 'thing' — artifact restricts the class to MADE things, which is what keeps the inductive claim true. (3) Do NOT define the class semantically. 'Something somebody meant something by' is the exact circularity library/originlife.html names by name; the card must rest on the functional definition (aperiodic AND sequence-specific). (4) Never 'only a mind CAN produce it' — the claim is that only intelligent agency is KNOWN, FROM REPEATED EXPERIENCE, to produce it. (5) The card asserts no proof and no consensus; Meyer's own conclusion is 'at present, the best explanation'.

name: every-code
sub: A paragraph. A program. A cipher. Trace any information-rich
artifact to its source and the trail ends at a mind.
There is one we have never traced. And you are made of it.
